explain START/REC, STOP/Stop Rec, PVR fallback, calibration, updates and lock.

links use each index's own mirror; corrupt index entries are reported/preserved
without hiding valid captures. Native setup transcripts are mirrored. Windows

browser checks pass. The operator package excludes project source and engineering
guides. Universal lock remains disabled for testing. Firmware354, safety limits,
calibration, SysID and stored settings are unchanged. Independent/physical/fleet
qualification and the historical crash diagnosis remain separate.
